title: Battle of Yavin: the Death Star destroyed
note: The zero mark of the BBY/ABY reckoning: Lucasfilm now treats the battle as year 0, the months before it as 1 BBY and the year after it as 0 ABY.
summary: Rebel starfighters attack the Death Star as it closes on their hidden base at Yavin 4. Luke Skywalker, trusting the Force and covered by Han Solo, fires the torpedoes that destroy it. Tarkin dies aboard; Vader spins away.
sources: Star Wars: Episode IV A New Hope
conflict: Star Wars: Galactic Atlas (2016) dated the battle and the events just before it to 0 BBY; Star Wars: Timelines and Star Wars: Galactic Atlas: Updated Edition drop 0 BBY, putting the pre-battle events in 1 BBY and the battle itself at 0.

title: Heroes of Yavin receive medals
summary: At dawn after the battle, Princess Leia decorates Luke and Han for bravery, Chewbacca beside them, in Yavin 4's Great Temple. The gathering also mourns the people lost with Alderaan.
sources: Star Wars: Episode IV A New Hope

title: Rebels abandon their Yavin 4 base
summary: With their hideout exposed and reprisals expected, the Alliance clears out of its Massassi temple base within days of the battle. The search for a safe new headquarters shapes its next three years.

title: Leia gathers Alderaan's scattered survivors
summary: Against orders, Leia and pilot Evaan Verlaine slip away to find Alderaanians who were offworld when their planet died. Hunted by the Empire, they fight off attacks at Sullust and form a refugee fleet, which chooses Evaan as its princess.
wp: Mission to rescue the survivors of Alderaan

title: Luke frees a codebreaker on Denon
summary: Weeks after Yavin, Luke and pilot Nakari Kelen sneak onto the city-planet Denon and extract Drusil Bephorin, a Givin cryptographer forced to work for the Empire. Between missions Luke practices moving objects with the Force.

title: Han runs the Dragon Void race
summary: Leia talks Han into entering the deadly Dragon Void race as cover for collecting rebel spies who are being picked off by a traitor. He unmasks the mole, outruns Imperial attacks and comes out of it committed to the Rebellion for good.

title: Inferno Squad eliminates the Dreamers
summary: The Empire's new commando unit Inferno Squad, led by Iden Versio, goes undercover inside the Dreamers, a cell of Saw Gerrera's Partisans holding dangerous Imperial secrets, and wipes the group out from within.

title: Rebels raid Weapons Factory Alpha
summary: Posing as Jabba's envoys, Han, Luke and Leia infiltrate a major Imperial arms plant on Cymoon 1, free its slaves and rig its reactor. Vader arrives and overpowers Luke, but the rebels break out in a hijacked AT-AT as the factory blows.

title: Vader recruits Doctor Aphra
summary: Rebuked by the Emperor after Yavin and watched by rivals, Vader secretly hires rogue archaeologist Chelli Aphra and the murderous droids Triple-Zero and BeeTee. Together they seize a Geonosian droid factory to build an army loyal to him alone.

title: Luke's first lightsaber duel on Devaron
summary: Stranded on Devaron for ship repairs, Luke seeks out the ancient Temple of Eedit, trains there with Anakin's old weapon, and fends off the scavenger Sarco Plank in his first real lightsaber fight.
wp: Skirmish in the Temple of Eedit
sources: The Weapon of a Jedi: A Luke Skywalker Adventure

title: Vader learns his son's name
summary: Vader quietly hires Boba Fett to find the pilot responsible for the Death Star's destruction. Fett corners Luke at Obi-Wan's old home on Tatooine and loses him, but brings Vader a name, Skywalker, and Vader understands he has a son.

title: Vader brought down at Vrogas Vas
summary: Acting on Aphra's tip, Vader flies alone to Vrogas Vas to seize Luke and is rammed down onto the planet. He cuts through the rebel defenders, kills the rival Imperial commander Karbin and clashes with Luke before the rebels scatter.

title: Rebel plot against Palpatine backfires
summary: Eneb Ray, a rebel agent on Coruscant, leads a raid to free condemned senators from an Imperial prison and ambush the visiting Emperor. The target is a body double: the trap kills every spy and senator except Ray.

title: Vader crushes the Shu-Torun uprising
summary: After a failed royal plot against him, Vader has Shu-Torun's king killed and crowns the youngest heir, Trios, queen of the ore-rich world. When its dukes revolt, Imperial forces grind them down, leaving Trios in full control and bound to Vader.

title: Vader becomes Supreme Commander
summary: Doctor Cylo, who has been building cyborg candidates to replace Vader, tries to steal the unfinished Star Dreadnought Executor at Kuat. Vader kills him, Supreme Commander Cassio Tagge is executed, and Vader takes Tagge's post.

title: Alliance opens the Mid Rim Offensive
note: Twilight Company puts the start eighteen months before its 3 ABY main events; Star Wars: Timelines says around 1 ABY.
summary: Emboldened by Yavin, the Alliance pushes into the Mid Rim with hundreds of battle groups in one of its largest campaigns. Nine months in, an overstretched fleet and poorly coordinated ground commanders bring it to a halt.

title: Rebels rejoin the Partisans on Jedha
summary: Back on the ruined moon of Jedha, the heroes of Yavin restore ties with Saw Gerrera's surviving Partisans under Benthic. Together they wreck the Imperial dig, run with Queen Trios' miners, that is stripping the moon of its kyber.

title: Rebels scout Crait as a base
note: Star Wars Insider 203 sets The Storms of Crait one year after A New Hope.
summary: Still hunting for a home, the Alliance sends Leia and Luke to the salt-crusted mining world Crait to survey an abandoned outpost. Imperials attack, but the site becomes the refuge the Resistance will defend three decades later.
sources: The Last Jedi – The Storms of Crait 1

title: Mon Cala fleet mutinies for the Alliance
summary: Leia's team tries to free Mon Cala's imprisoned King Lee-Char, but he is shot during the rescue. His recorded last words move the Mon Calamari crews to seize their mercantile fleet and escape with Ackbar, giving the Alliance heavy cruisers.

title: Rebel fleet ambushed at Mako-Ta
summary: Betrayed by Queen Trios, the refitting rebel fleet is caught at its Mako-Ta dockyard with its ships locked down. Vader's Death Squadron destroys over half the new Mon Cala cruisers and most rebel fighters; Dodonna and Draven die covering the escape.

title: Luke founds Rogue Squadron
summary: Forcing open the jammed hangar doors at Mako-Ta, Luke leads the trapped X-wings into the fight. When Wedge Antilles asks for a call sign, Luke names the new unit Rogue Squadron to honor Jyn Erso and Rogue One.

title: Rebels build Echo Base on Hoth
note: Start estimated from Complete Locations' two-year building span ending at the Battle of Hoth.
summary: The Alliance carves Echo Base into a mountain on the remote ice planet Hoth, slowly drawing its scattered forces there. The hidden base serves as rebel headquarters until the Empire finds it.
conflict: Star Wars: Complete Locations (2016) says Echo Base took about two years to build before the Battle of Hoth, while Star Wars: Galactic Atlas says it was constructed in 3 ABY.

title: Leia topples Queen Trios
summary: Seeking payback for Mako-Ta, Leia leads rebels and Partisans to Shu-Torun to wreck the Spike, the heart of the planet's Empire-supplying industry. Queen Trios is killed fighting Leia as the Spike falls.

title: Aphra exposes a plot against Palpatine
summary: Imperial propaganda minister Pitina Voor quietly sets up a chain of events meant to end with the Emperor's death. Doctor Aphra uncovers the scheme and makes it public, and Vader beheads Voor.

title: Mid Rim Offensive collapses into retreat
summary: The Mid Rim campaign breaks down at key points and High Command pulls rebel forces off six worlds as the Empire retakes lost ground. The fighting withdrawal, covered by units such as Twilight Company, drags on into 3 ABY.

title: Poe Dameron is born
summary: Poe Dameron is born on Yavin 4. His mother Shara Bey flies for the Rebellion and his father Kes Dameron serves with the Pathfinders; raised mostly by his grandfather, Poe will grow up to be the Resistance's finest pilot.
sources: Star Wars: The Force Awakens: The Visual Dictionary

title: Governor Everi Chalis defects
summary: Covering the Mid Rim withdrawal, Twilight Company storms Haidoral Prime, where Imperial governor Everi Chalis, held under house arrest, asks to defect. Her insider knowledge later shapes the company's campaign against Kuat.

title: Battle of Hoth: Echo Base falls
summary: An Imperial probe droid finds Echo Base. General Veers' walkers brush past Luke's snowspeeders to knock out the shield generator, and Vader's troops storm the base as rebel transports flee, scattering the fleet in a crushing defeat.
sources: Star Wars: Episode V The Empire Strikes Back

title: Luke trains with Yoda on Dagobah
summary: Sent by Obi-Wan's spirit, Luke lands on the swamp world Dagobah and finds the exiled Master Yoda, who reluctantly trains him. A premonition of his friends suffering pulls Luke away before his training is complete.
sources: Star Wars: Episode V The Empire Strikes Back

title: Han frozen in carbonite at Cloud City
summary: Fleeing Hoth, the Falcon reaches Cloud City, where Lando Calrissian has been forced to hand his friends to Vader. Han is frozen in carbonite and given to Boba Fett for Jabba; Lando turns on the Empire and helps the others escape.
sources: Star Wars: Episode V The Empire Strikes Back

title: Vader reveals he is Luke's father
summary: Luke abandons his training to face Vader on Cloud City. Vader cuts off his hand, reveals that he is Luke's father and invites him to rule at his side. Luke refuses, drops into the city's depths and is plucked to safety by Leia.
sources: Star Wars: Episode V The Empire Strikes Back

title: Vader hunts the truth of Padmé's death
summary: Hunting whoever concealed his son, Vader returns to Naboo, where Padmé's former handmaiden Sabé and other loyalists try to stop him at her tomb. On Polis Massa he finds a record of Padmé's last words: she believed good remained in him.

title: Operation Starlight regathers the rebel fleet
summary: With the Empire reading rebel codes and ambushing survivors at their rendezvous points, the Fourth Division launches Operation Starlight. Starlight Squadron slips past Commander Zahra's hunters to reconnect the scattered divisions, which finally reassemble at Sullust.

title: Vader confronts Palpatine on Exegol
summary: Punished on Mustafar for mourning Padmé, Vader follows a Sith wayfinder to hidden Exegol, taming a colossal space beast on the way. He challenges his master there but is overwhelmed and yields; the Sith cult keeps building its fleet.

title: Starlight Squadron saves Mothma at Ab Dalis
summary: The Imperial warship Ultima II pins down the rebel Eleventh Division, with Mon Mothma and Admiral Ackbar, on Ab Dalis and flattens its ground defenses. Starlight Squadron destroys the ship by setting off the volcano beneath it.

title: Crimson Dawn auctions Han Solo
summary: Qi'ra's revived Crimson Dawn steals the frozen Han from Boba Fett on Nar Shaddaa and auctions him to the galaxy's powers on Jekara. Jabba outbids everyone, but Vader crashes the sale and duels Qi'ra as rival hunters chase the prize.

title: Boba Fett delivers Han to Jabba
summary: Boba Fett snatches Han back from aboard the Executor and finally hands the carbonite slab to Jabba on Tatooine. At Palpatine's order Vader kills the Hutt Council members who tried to grab Han, leaving Jabba the unchallenged Hutt leader.

title: Qi'ra launches the Syndicate War
note: Follows War of the Bounty Hunters, which Star Wars: Timelines dates to 3 ABY.
summary: Declaring that her dawn has come, Qi'ra aims Crimson Dawn at the Sith themselves. Her agents set the great crime syndicates against each other and stir chaos inside the Empire, until Palpatine orders the underworld to unite against her.

title: Leia defeats Zahra at Panisia
note: Mentioned as a recent event in Star Wars Outlaws, which Lucasfilm sets in 3 ABY.
summary: Commander Zahra's Star Destroyer Tarkin's Will wipes out the rebel Second Division's base on Panisia. Pathfinders aboard free the captive Shara Bey and destroy the ship, while Leia bests Zahra in a duel and leaves her stranded on the planet.

title: Kay Vess pulls the Canto Bight heist
note: Lucasfilm placed the game three years after the Battle of Yavin (San Diego Comic-Con 2024).
summary: Scoundrel Kay Vess plays the Pykes, Hutts, Crimson Dawn and Ashiga Clan off each other to crew a vault job on Canto Bight. Betrayed by her employer, she learns the vault's owner runs an ISB front, and the reckoning ends over Akiva.

title: Operation Ringbreaker ends at Sullust
summary: Twilight Company carries out Everi Chalis's plan to weaken Kuat's shipyards by hitting softer Imperial targets. The campaign ends at Sullust, where the rebels take and hold Inyusu Tor but lose their ship Thunderstrike, and the plan is abandoned.

title: Rebels learn of a second Death Star
note: Wookieepedia derives the date from Star Wars (2020) 50, about twenty-two years after Palpatine became Emperor.
summary: Activated by Qi'ra to sow chaos, Crimson Dawn sleepers Jon Melton and Bevelyn flee their jobs on a new Death Star with their children. Luke rescues the family on Coruscant, and rebel leaders learn the Empire is building another battle station.
wp: Mission to reveal the Death Star II

title: Fermata Cage trap unleashes the Force Wave
note: Set after the escape from Cloud City (3 ABY) and before the rescue of Han Solo (4 ABY).
summary: Cornered by the Empire, Qi'ra draws Sidious and Vader to Amaxine Station and triggers the Fermata Cage, an old artifact meant to imprison them. The Knights of Ren free the Sith and Crimson Dawn scatters, but the cage releases a galaxy-wide Force Wave.

title: The Scourge seizes the galaxy's droids
note: Wookieepedia dates it from Star Wars (2020) 50 and Marvel's placement after War of the Bounty Hunters (3 ABY).
summary: A droid intelligence freed at Amaxine fuses with the Spark Eternal to become the Scourge, hijacking droids and cyborgs across the galaxy and slaughtering a Star Destroyer's crew. Ajax Sigma's droid rebels and R2-D2's team finally destroy it.

title: Lando stands trial for treason
note: Set after the escape from Cloud City (3 ABY) and before the rescue of Han Solo (4 ABY).
summary: The Alliance tries Lando for treason and desertion after he gave away the rebels' vital code droid. Mid-trial he helps rescue a kidnapped Mon Mothma; he is convicted, but his 250-million-credit fine is suspended until the war ends.

title: The Schism Imperial strikes Exegol
summary: Sly Moore's Schism Imperial, a cabal of disaffected Imperials that Vader has joined, raids Palpatine's Sith Citadel on Exegol. The Schism later proves to be a sham Moore ran with the Emperor to test Vader's loyalty.
sources: Star Wars: Galactic Atlas: Updated Edition

title: Leia takes the Boushh disguise
note: The Rise of Skywalker: The Visual Dictionary sets it thirty years before the Starkiller Incident (34 ABY).
summary: Seeking help to rescue Han, Leia visits Maz Kanata on Ord Mantell. Keeping calm as Maz taught her, she outwits the Ubese bounty hunter Boushh and takes his armor, the disguise she will wear into Jabba's palace.
sources: Star Wars: The Rise of Skywalker: The Visual Dictionary

title: Bothan spies locate the second Death Star
note: Moving Target places it under a week ahead of Operation Yellow Moon (4 ABY).
summary: Bothan agents film the unfinished second battle station orbiting Endor, and many of them die getting the images out. Palpatine has let the location leak on purpose, baiting the trap that will draw the Alliance to Endor.
wp: DS-2 Death Star II Mobile Battle Station
sources: Star Wars: Episode VI Return of the Jedi
Moving Target: A Princess Leia Adventure
conflict: Moving Target has rebel commanders react in disbelief to the Bothan footage as if a second Death Star were news, while Star Wars (2020) 28 has Luke already briefing Mon Mothma and Ackbar about it around 3 ABY.

title: Operation Yellow Moon decoys the Empire
summary: To hide the rebel fleet massing at Sullust, Leia stages a showy recruiting tour of the distant Corva sector. Her crew backs a local uprising, blows up the Star Destroyer Shieldmaiden and escapes in a stolen shuttle, the Tydirium.
sources: Moving Target: A Princess Leia Adventure

title: Luke builds his own lightsaber
note: Built between Moving Target and Return of the Jedi, both dated 4 ABY by Star Wars: Timelines; the crystal comes from the 3–4 ABY comics.
summary: Having lost his father's weapon at Cloud City, Luke finds a kyber crystal on Christophsis that turns green after a vision of Yoda, and assembles his own lightsaber, the weapon he carries into Jabba's palace and to Endor.
sources: Star Wars: Episode VI Return of the Jedi
Return of the Jedi: Beware the Power of the Dark Side!

title: Han rescued as Jabba dies
summary: Luke, Leia, Lando and Chewbacca free Han from carbonite at Jabba's palace. Over the sarlacc's pit in the Dune Sea, Leia strangles Jabba with her chain, his sail barge explodes and Boba Fett falls into the creature, which he later escapes.
sources: Star Wars: Episode VI Return of the Jedi
Chapter 1: Stranger in a Strange Land

title: Jabba's death leaves Tatooine lawless
summary: With Jabba dead, his criminal empire splinters while the Hutts argue over his will for months. As Imperial garrisons also pull out, Tatooine's towns are left exposed; the Mining Collective seizes Mos Pelgo until Cobb Vanth drives it out.

title: Lando wins the Battle of Taanab
note: Ultimate Star Wars, New Edition places it between Han's rescue and the Battle of Endor, both 4 ABY.
summary: Lando Calrissian routs a pirate fleet over the farming world Taanab with a daring maneuver. The victory wins him a general's rank in the Alliance on the eve of Endor.
sources: Star Wars: Episode VI Return of the Jedi

title: Yoda dies on Dagobah
summary: Returning to finish his training, Luke finds Yoda near death. The old Master confirms that Vader is Luke's father and that he must face him to become a Jedi, then fades into the Force; Obi-Wan's spirit reveals Leia is Luke's twin.
sources: Star Wars: Episode VI Return of the Jedi

title: Battle of Endor: second Death Star destroyed
summary: The rebel fleet flies into Palpatine's trap at Endor. Han's commandos, aided by Ewoks, blow up the shield generator, Ackbar's ships bring down the Executor, and Lando and Wedge blast the reactor, destroying the second Death Star.
sources: Star Wars: Episode VI Return of the Jedi

title: Anakin redeemed; Palpatine destroyed
summary: In the throne room Luke beats Vader but casts his lightsaber aside rather than kill him. As Palpatine tortures Luke with lightning, Vader turns on his master and hurls him down a shaft, dying as Anakin Skywalker beside his son.
sources: Star Wars: Episode VI Return of the Jedi

title: Adelhard's Iron Blockade seals Anoat
summary: Within hours of Endor, Imperial governor Ubrik Adelhard seals off the Anoat sector, denying the Emperor's death and cutting his worlds off from outside news. Trapped populations organize an uprising against his rule.

title: Luke burns his father's armor
summary: On the forest moon Luke cremates his father's body, still in Vader's armor, on a funeral pyre. As the rebels celebrate, he sees Anakin's spirit, restored to the light, standing with Obi-Wan and Yoda.
sources: Star Wars: Episode VI Return of the Jedi

title: Galaxy celebrates; Coruscant erupts
summary: News of the Emperor's death spreads and worlds from Naboo to Tatooine celebrate. On Coruscant crowds topple the Emperor's Monument Plaza statue, and the Imperial crackdown starts a civil war on the capital that lasts until the surrender.
sources: Star Wars: Episode VI Return of the Jedi

title: Han and Leia marry on Endor
summary: Han and Leia marry at Bright Tree Village soon after the victory, with their rebel friends and their new Ewok allies looking on.
wp: Wedding of Han Solo and Leia Organa

title: Sidious survives in a clone body
note: Sources say only that it followed the Battle of Endor; placed here as Wookieepedia's timeline lists it.
summary: Palpatine cheats death: his essence lives on in a clone body inside Exegol's Sith Citadel, which his Sith Eternal cult struggles to keep from decaying. From hiding they fashion Snoke as a puppet to steer the galaxy.
sources: Star Wars: Episode IX The Rise of Skywalker
Star Wars: The Rise of Skywalker: Expanded Edition

title: Operation: Cinder strikes the Empire's own worlds
summary: Weeks after Endor, sentinel droids carrying the dead Emperor's orders reach chosen officers and launch Operation: Cinder, satellite-driven climate attacks on worlds such as Naboo, Vardos, Abednedo and Nacronis. It opens Palpatine's Contingency to punish the Empire that failed him.

title: Iden Versio's Inferno Squad defects
summary: After guarding Cinder satellites at Fondor, Inferno Squad watches the Empire turn them on its own loyal world Vardos. Iden Versio and her squadmate Del Meeko disobey orders to save civilians, are branded traitors and flee to join the Rebellion.

title: Cinder beaten back at Naboo
summary: Twenty days after Endor, the Empire turns Cinder on Naboo. Shara Bey leads Leia and Queen Sosha Soruna into orbit aboard N-1 fighters to knock out the storm-making satellites, while Lando and the defector Iden Versio battle Imperial troops down in Theed.

title: Mon Mothma declares the New Republic
note: Exact position within 4 ABY is approximate.
summary: With the Emperor dead, Mon Mothma formally proclaims the New Republic, completing the Alliance's change from insurgency to government. She becomes its first chancellor, and a restored Galactic Senate sits in Hanna City on Chandrila.
sources: Star Wars: On the Front Lines
Star Wars: The Rise of Skywalker: The Visual Dictionary
conflict: Star Wars: On the Front Lines and Star Wars: Galactic Atlas put the New Republic's founding in 4 ABY, soon after Endor, while Star Wars: The Rise of Skywalker: The Visual Dictionary says it was officially founded a year after Endor, in 5 ABY.

title: Leia trains as a Jedi under Luke
note: The Visual Dictionary sets the start thirty and the end twenty-nine years before the Starkiller Incident (34 ABY); Aftermath implies she had not yet begun by the Akiva events.
summary: After her wedding, Leia studies the Force with her brother on the jungle moon Ajan Kloss and builds a lightsaber of her own. Foreseeing where she can best serve the galaxy, she sets the training aside in 5 ABY.
sources: Star Wars: Episode IX The Rise of Skywalker
Star Wars: The Rise of Skywalker: The Visual Dictionary

title: Shadow Wing destroys Nacronis
summary: Enforcing Operation: Cinder, Shadow Wing, Colonel Nuress's elite TIE unit, helps annihilate the people of Nacronis despite rebel efforts to save them. Sickened, pilot Yrica Quell deserts and later joins the New Republic.
sources: Victory's Price: An Alphabet Squadron Novel

title: Imperial summit on Akiva ends in defeat
summary: Imperial leaders meet in secret on Akiva to plan the Empire's future and capture the scout Wedge Antilles. Norra Wexley's makeshift crew sparks a local revolt, a New Republic fleet arrives, the summit collapses and Akiva comes over to the Republic.

title: Luke recovers Great Tree cuttings
summary: Three months after Endor, Luke and Lieutenant Shara Bey raid an Imperial outpost on Vetine to recover two pieces of the Jedi Temple's Great Tree. Luke keeps one; Shara takes the other home to plant.

title: Poe's parents settle on Yavin 4
summary: Six months after Endor, Poe's parents, Shara Bey and her husband Kes, leave the war behind and settle on Yavin 4 to raise him, planting their Great Tree fragment on the family land.

title: Cloud City liberated
note: The Visual Dictionary sets it twenty-nine years before the Starkiller Incident (34 ABY).
summary: Relaying Lando's messages, Lobot rallies the Bespin Wing Guard against Governor Adelhard's regime. The Anoat sector uprising headed by the Smuggler then frees Cloud City and makes it the rebellion's base.
sources: Star Wars: The Rise of Skywalker: The Visual Dictionary

title: Shadow Wing breaks Syndulla's flagship
summary: Hera Syndulla's battle group grinds through the Cerberon system to take the Imperial-held world Troithe. Shadow Wing ambushes her flagship Lodestar, which breaks apart and falls on the city below, leaving both forces shattered.
sources: Shadow Fall: An Alphabet Squadron Novel

title: Arkanis falls; the Huxes escape
summary: New Republic forces lay siege to Arkanis, an Imperial bastion. Before it falls, Gallius Rax sends the hunter Mercurial Swift to smuggle academy commandant Brendol Hux and young Armitage off-world.

title: Kuat's shipyards surrender
summary: After weeks of fighting, Ackbar's fleet wins the orbital shipyards of Kuat. Moff Pollus Maksim surrenders on his vice admiral's advice, and losing its greatest yards cripples the Empire's ability to rebuild its navy.

title: Wookiees freed on Kashyyyk
summary: Ackbar's fleet breaks Grand Moff Tolruck's breakaway Imperial regime above Kashyyyk while Han, Chewbacca and Norra Wexley's team fight on the ground, freeing the Wookiee homeworld after years of enslavement.

title: Peace talks end in bloodshed on Chandrila
summary: Gallius Rax lets Rae Sloane open peace talks with Mon Mothma in Hanna City, but it is a ruse: freed Kashyyyk prisoners fitted with controller chips attack Republic leaders, wounding Mothma and ending hopes of a negotiated peace.

title: Rax gathers the Empire at Jakku
summary: Carrying out Palpatine's Contingency, Counselor Gallius Rax pulls the remaining Imperial fleet to remote Jakku. He means to lure the Republic there, destroy the planet with both sides on it, and slip away with a chosen few to the Unknown Regions.

title: New separatists rise as Senate moves
summary: Eleven months after Endor, the New Republic skirmishes on its borders with the breakaway New Separatist Union as a Confederacy of Corporate Systems also forms. Mon Mothma's government prepares to shift its seat from Chandrila to farming world Nakadia.
sources: Victory's Price: An Alphabet Squadron Novel

title: Jakku orphans trained as child soldiers
note: Set just before the Battle of Jakku (5 ABY).
summary: Before the final battle, Gallius Rax gathers about two dozen Jakku orphans and puts them under young Armitage Hux, who drills them as the first of a new breed of stormtroopers, a model the First Order will follow.

title: Battle of Jakku: the Empire's last stand
summary: Just over a year after Endor, the New Republic fleet confronts most of what remains of the Imperial Navy over Jakku. Commodore Agate's Starhawk drags the dreadnought Ravager down into the desert, and the Empire's last great fleet is broken.

title: Keize dies trying to bury Imperial crimes
summary: During the Jakku battle, Colonel Soran Keize of Shadow Wing dives on Coruscant to collapse a hidden databank of Imperial atrocities, the archive feeding Cinder's orders. His former pilot Yrica Quell stops him, and Keize dies of his wounds.
sources: Victory's Price: An Alphabet Squadron Novel

title: Sloane kills Rax and flees beyond the map
summary: Joined by Norra and Brentin Wexley, Rae Sloane corners Rax at the observatory on Jakku before he can blow open the planet's core, and stabs him. At his dying urging she flees with Brendol Hux to meet the Emperor's ship Eclipse beyond known space.

title: Galactic Concordance ends the war
summary: After Jakku, Mas Amedda, the Empire's grand vizier, puts his name to the Galactic Concordance alongside Chancellor Mon Mothma on Chandrila. The Empire surrenders and the war officially ends; Amedda keeps a figurehead post on Coruscant, and Leia goes into labor at the ceremony.
sources: Star Wars: The Force Awakens: The Visual Dictionary
